bugs.explanation: Images below the fold (not visible on initial page load) should have `loading="lazy"` to defer loading until the user scrolls near them. This significantly reduces initial page load time. Above-the-fold images should use `loading="eager"` (the default).

`rel="preload"` hints to the browser to fetch a resource early (before the regular cascade discovers it). Adding a preload hint for critical CSS improves render performance by starting the download sooner.

Without `font-display`, the browser uses its default (often `block`) — invisible text during font load. `font-display: swap` shows fallback text immediately and swaps to the custom font when it loads, preventing FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text).

title: CSS Transition on display

bugs.explanation: `display: none` cannot be transitioned — elements jump instantly between hidden and visible. Use `visibility: hidden` + `opacity: 0` instead. `visibility` can be transitioned (although it still jumps, it's combined with opacity for a fade effect). Or use `clip-path`, `height`, or the `@starting-style` rule.
